title: Cerulean_Cave
lead_summary:
Cerulean Cave is only accessed by Route 4 after obtaining Waterfall.
2F is a dark room that requires either HM08 Flash or its HM Replacement Item.
Mewtwo is a static encounter at the end of 3F.

items.name: Super Potion
items.location_details: Hidden by a rock near the North-West ladder.

items.name: Strange Prism
items.location_details: Near the South-East corner, from the Eastern path.

items.name: PP Up
items.location_details: Near the South-West, from the Center path.

items.name: Dusk Ball
items.location_details: Near the South-West corner, from the South-Western Path.
